explication: This Terraform module accepts bucket configuration and declares AWS S3 resources to create or manage. Its documented capabilities span bucket settings, access controls, replication, notifications, and newer S3 resource types. The tree identifies dedicated modules for some capabilities; the README documents others in the root module. Source excerpts were unavailable, so links between internal components are limited to documented module use and provisioning.
